task: Find technical specs for the latest Macbook Air on Apple.
agent_final_answer:
The latest MacBook Air on Apple is the M5 model. Technical specs (13-inch) from apple.com/macbook-air/specs/:

- Chip: Apple M5 chip; 10-core CPU (4 super cores + 6 efficiency cores); 8-core GPU (configurable to 10-core GPU); Neural Accelerators; hardware-accelerated ray tracing; 16-core Neural Engine; 153GB/s memory bandwidth. Media Engine supports H.264, HEVC, ProRes, ProRes RAW, and AV1 decode.
- Memory: 16GB unified memory (configurable to 24GB or 32GB)
- Storage: 512GB SSD (configurable to 1TB, 2TB, or 4TB)
- Display: 13.6-inch Liquid Retina, LED-backlit IPS, 2560-by-1664 at 224 ppi, 500 nits brightness; 1 billion colors, Wide color (P3), True Tone
- Battery and Power: Up to 18 hours video streaming, up to 15 hours wireless web; built-in 53.8-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery; 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max; USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable; fast-charge capable
- Charging/Expansion: MagSafe 3 charging port; 3.5 mm headphone jack; two Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) ports (up to 40Gb/s, support charging, DisplayPort, USB 4)
- External Display: supports up to two external displays (up to 6K at 60Hz)
- Wireless: Apple N1 wireless chip; Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be); Bluetooth 6; Thread networking
- Camera: 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View; 1080p HD video recording
- Audio: Four-speaker sound system; three-mic array; Spatial Audio
- Keyboard/Trackpad: Backlit Magic Keyboard with Touch ID; Force Touch trackpad
- Operating System: macOS with Apple Intelligence
- Size and Weight: Height 0.44 in (1.13 cm), Width 11.97 in (30.41 cm), Depth 8.46 in (21.5 cm), Weight 2.7 lb (1.23 kg)
- Finishes: Sky Blue, Silver, Starlight, Midnight; Price from $1099 (also available in a 15-inch size)
